User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the Défi45j application.

sessionId.description: The ID of the session the user belongs to. Null for Admins.

lastActivity.description: The timestamp of the user's last activity.

profileComplete.description: Indicates if the user has completed their onboarding profile.

sponsorFirstName.description: The first name of the user's sponsor (parrain/marraine).

sponsorLastName.description: The last name of the user's sponsor (parrain/marraine).

archived.description: Indicates if the user account is archived and cannot be logged into.

conferenceDate.description: The date of the user's planned conference.

guestGoal.description: The user's goal for the number of guests at their conference.

conferenceGuestCount.description: The current number of registered guests for the user's conference.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Represents a session created by an Admin.

name.description: The name of the session (e.g., 'Défi Pro Xavier').

secretCode.description: The unique secret code for this session.

adminId.description: The ID of the Admin who created this session.

startDate.description: The start date of the 45-day challenge.

endDate.description: The end date of the 45-day challenge.

organizerName.description: The name of the organizer responsible for this session.

archived.description: Indicates if the session is archived.

ChallengeProgress.title: Challenge Progress
ChallengeProgress.description: Stores a user's total progress for a specific challenge session. This is an aggregation and may be deprecated.

r1Count.description: Total count for Prise de connaissance.

wellnessCompletedDays.description: Array of dates where at least one wellness routine was completed.

DailyChallengeProgress.title: Daily Challenge Progress
DailyChallengeProgress.description: Stores a user's challenge progress for a single day.

date.description: The date of the progress entry (YYYY-MM-DD).

MoodEntry.title: Mood Entry
MoodEntry.description: Represents a user's daily mood entry.

date.description: The date of the mood entry (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: The title corresponding to the mood level.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the entry was created.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Users can read their own data. Admins have broader access.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores session data. Admins can create/manage sessions. Consultants can read the session they belong to.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the session.

definition.description: Stores a user's total progress for a challenge. This may be deprecated in favor of daily summaries.
Stores a summary of a user's challenge actions for a single day.
Stores a user's daily mood entry. Users can read/write their own entries.

params.name: moodEntryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the mood entry, typically `${userId}_${date}`.
